WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=60 THEN AVG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode, b.tgtcode AS tgtcode, b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `m1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b

FROM base
WHERE ((`m1` + ?) >= ? AND (`m1` + ?) <= ?)

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,c.name AS name,c.hyBlkRefName AS hyBlkRefName,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  LEFT JOIN newzl.hsj_stock_code_info c ON c.mktcode=b.mktcode AND c.tgtcode=b.tgtcode
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    AVG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY hyBlkRefName,bizdate) AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`,
    b.openPrice AS `v2`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    CASE WHEN `v1` IS NOT NULL AND `v2` IS NOT NULL AND LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) IS NOT NULL AND LAG(`v2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) IS NOT NULL THEN (`v1`>`v2` AND LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate)<=LAG(`v2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE `f1`
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    `v1` AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > ?) AS `pc1`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`
  FROM predicates
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM counted WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE `c1`
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    q.symbol AS symbol,
    q.trade_date AS trade_date
  FROM market.dwd_quote_daily q
  WHERE q.trade_date = ?
)
SELECT `symbol`, `trade_date`
FROM base
WHERE trade_date = ?
  AND (`close` IS NULL)
LIMIT 5;
